scope: Finite synthetic mathematics and Hilbert-space candidate; ontology remains ONTO; no physical creditation
beta_policy: Read unique top-level ALPHA_FINE_CODATA_2018 assignment from pinned um.py bytes without executing; beta=alpha*sqrt(e) at runtime

optical.T: entrywise |S|^2 on populations; D o Ad_S o D on density matrices
optical.assumption: Complete dephasing D before and after each S scattering; explicitly added synthetic channel assumption
optical.R: orthogonal projection onto ker(I-T); primary population R=ones(2,2)/2; density R(rho)=Tr(rho)*I/2
optical.regime: S is angular unitary reading. Iterated T is dissipative population face. T=R+lambda*(I-R), lambda=1-2beta; for 0<beta<1/2 population T=exp(a*(X-I)), a=-log(1-2beta)/2. This explicit normalized hyperbolic representation does not identify the entire canonical boost dynamics.

hypotheses.A1_general: Hilbert continuous linear contraction ||T||<=1 gives Cesaro convergence. Strong convergence only for named strict-complement finite family.
hypotheses.A4: e nonzero, T e=e and StrictComplementContraction: exists 0<=c<1, for x perpendicular to span(e), ||T x||<=c||x||; hence Fix(T)=span(e). Unique state only after sum/trace normalization.
hypotheses.not_sufficient: Noncommuting jumps alone do not imply global uniqueness; no strict contraction imposed on entire Hilbert space.

A1.statement: Primary finite face T^n x tends to Rx for all x; general Hilbert Cesaro variant separately
A1.falsifier: With the named hypotheses, violation of power formula/bound or a proven nonconvergent trajectory; finite sampling alone is not universal proof
A1.numerical: operator-norm power formula and bound for fixed n; final ||T^4096-R||<=1e-10; Cesaro checks exact finite formula and O(1/N) bound, NOT 1e-10 distance to R
A1.lean: reuse existing mean ergodic theorem; constructive finite witness

A2.statement: R o T=R and T o R=R
A2.falsifier: Either operator residual>1e-10 or a named-hypothesis counterexample

A3.statement: R^2=R; R=R* and equals orthogonal/spectral projector onto Fix(T)
A3.letter: Use A=I-T; population q(z)=z-2beta, q(A)/q(0)=R and A*q(A)=0. The full minimal polynomial X*q annihilates A; q alone annihilates the transient complement.
A3.observer: observing_adds_nothing is the structural idempotence pattern; do not identify angular projPlus with the dissipative R by homonym

A4.statement: dim Fix(T)=1 under StrictComplementContraction and nonzero fixed e
A4.falsifier: dim>1 under hypothesis; ambiguous rank is visible failure/refusal
A4.normalization: sum p=1 or Tr(rho)=1 yields the unique fixed state

controls.definition: Ad(S*) o D_t o Ad(S), t=1, offdiagonal multiplier exp(-1), existing GlobalLiftLadder
controls.fixed_states: S* E00 S and S* E11 S

controls.scope: OUTSIDE_LINEAR_CPTP_CLASS; linear maps fix zero and finite CPTP channels have a stationary state. Fixed point equation x+1=x impossible; x_n=n, means (N-1)/2.

numerics.policy: NaN/Inf/ambiguous rank fail closed; fix criteria before first run. Report finite checks separately from theorem.
numerics.analytical_bound: ||T^n-R||<=|lambda|^n; mean<=1/(N*(1-|lambda|)); use same bound for density channel N>=1 with zero eigenvalues handled exactly.
